Review of the draft:

- **"Certified organic by the Soil Association."** This is on the claims allowlist, so it is fine.
- **"Just peppermint leaves, nothing else."** This is a product fact about ingredients, so it is fine as written.
- **"Cool and clean after a big meal."** This describes flavour and the experience of drinking it. It doesn't claim a digestive benefit (such as aiding digestion), so I don't read it as a health claim.
- No invented stats, superlatives, guarantees, testimonials, urgency, green claims beyond the allowed organic certification, or missing disclosures.
- The copy is short and specific, without filler phrasing.

Nothing needs changing, so it can be published.
